name: Reuse standard components before creating local primitives
statement: Before creating a local button, badge, panel, dialog, tab, status indicator, or other UI primitive, reuse or extend the standard component and shared primitive already serving that role.
rationale: One-off primitives duplicate interaction, accessibility, and visual behavior. Reuse preserves the Agent Studio family language and concentrates fixes in one implementation.

badExample.description: A feature recreates a status badge

goodExample.description: The feature uses the shared status primitive

history.change: Initial default-on rule covering the operator-observed missing component reuse defect class.
